teams.title: Start with one team
teams.text: In a small organisation one team is enough — for example Hotel, Practice or Facility. Add everyone who carries out tasks to that team (name + icon). A team leader is not required. Add extra teams later only if there are genuinely separate groups. Then link the team to your categories.

categories.title: Start by creating categories
categories.text: Go to Places → Categories and add categories to group units (e.g. rooms, sanitary, office). One team may be linked to every category — tasks then reach the same people. With several teams, link each team to the categories it works on. Then add locations under Places → Locations and create units per location — or via Places → Units.

locations.title: Start by creating locations and units
locations.text: Go to Places → Locations, add locations and create units per location (machines, rooms, assets). You can also import units via CSV or Excel, or create them in bulk.

units.title: Start by creating units
units.text: Open your location and add units (machines, rooms, assets). You can add units one by one, in bulk, or via CSV/Excel.

clock_point.title: Create a Clock Point
clock_point.text: Workers sign in and clock in/out via a Clock Point. Create at least one clock point and print the QR sticker or QR print sheet so your team can get started.

register_success.title: Account created
register_success.body: Your workspace is ready. You can start managing your first tasks now.

starter_pack.help_button: Would you like a hand getting started?
starter_pack.intro: We will create a small sample setup so you can try WinProx right away. No issues or tasks — structure only.
starter_pack.will_create: This will be added to your workspace:
starter_pack.will_create_items: two teams, a few categories, one location and three units. Names are stored in every language.
starter_pack.rename_note: You can always rename teams, categories, locations and units.
starter_pack.issues_note: Once a unit has issues, it can only be deactivated (not deleted). The starter template then remains.
starter_pack.result_next: Open a unit, print the QR and submit your first issue.
starter_pack.remove_text: Teams, categories, location and units from the starter template will be deleted. Anything you added yourself stays.
starter_pack.remove_issues_note: If issues already exist, units can only be deactivated and the template remains.

errors.unknown: This starter template is not available.
errors.already_applied: A starter template is already loaded.
errors.not_empty: You already have teams, categories, locations or units. The starter template is only for an empty workspace.
errors.missing: There is no starter template to remove.
errors.has_issues: There are already issues or workers. Units can then only be deactivated; the starter template remains. You can always rename.
